gloss: overall picture; big picture; full scope

definitions.gloss: overall picture; big picture; full scope
definitions.explanation: The complete view or comprehensive understanding of something, including all its parts and aspects.

examples.japanese: {全体像|ぜんたいぞう}をつかむ。
まず{計画|けいかく}の{全体像|ぜんたいぞう}を{説明|せつめい}します。
examples.english: First, I will explain the overall picture of the plan.

examples.japanese: {細|こま}かい{部分|ぶぶん}にとらわれず、{全体像|ぜんたいぞう}を{見|み}ることが{大事|だいじ}だ。
examples.english: It is important to look at the big picture without getting caught up in the details.

notes:
Compound noun: {全体|ぜんたい} (whole, entirety) + {像|ぞう} (image, picture). Commonly used in business presentations and academic contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {全体像|ぜんたいぞう}をつかむ (to grasp the big picture)
- {全体像|ぜんたいぞう}を{把握|はあく}する (to comprehend the full scope)
- {全体像|ぜんたいぞう}を{示|しめ}す (to show the overall picture)
- {全体像|ぜんたいぞう}が{見|み}える (the full picture becomes clear)
